description: Add one pull-feed watch on a country, a domain or an incident type (censorship, mixed, disruption) for your relay identity. Send X-Agent-Key in the MCP request header and confirm:true; no webhook or HMAC key is needed. Events are public incident records first recorded after the watch was created, never a current reachability verdict.

confirm.description: Required true to store the watch

name: voidly_watch_add
